name: KoPunch
description: KO II Punch-In FX inspired performance pad for NTS-3. Continuously captures AUDIO IN (get_raw_input on firmware 1.4+). Hold the pad to engage; release to bypass. X = mode (PRND, SWAP, GRAN, RPT, TAPE, FLFO, LPF, HPF, SEND, TREM, OCTD, DEC). Y = pressure / intensity. Depth = wet. COLOR = filter resonance / send character. HOLD: GATE or LATCH. Not affiliated with teenage engineering.

params.name: MODE
params.detail: PRND pitch random, SWAP slice swap, GRAN granulizer, RPT beat repeat, TAPE tape stop, FLFO filter LFO, LPF, HPF, SEND delay throw, TREM tremolo, OCTD octave down, DEC decimator

params.name: PRESS
params.detail: Pressure intensity (cutoff, speed, grain size, crush, etc.)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the punch-in effect is engaged

params.name: COLOR
params.detail: Filter resonance, send feedback/tone, or grain density

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to engage. LATCH = stays after release; switch back to GATE to stop
